clause: Save/load selection to alpha/spare channel (shared with Channels) [STU-RAS-022]

scope.summary: Implement saving a StudioSelectionSet to a persistent alpha/spare channel and reloading it as a selection, preserved in round-trippable interchange formats (14.13). Save/load selection, alpha channels, and the Channels surface (§7, MT-050) MUST be one shared mechanism — do not build a second store.
acceptance_criteria: selection persists to an alpha/spare channel and reloads identically
shares the Channels mechanism; round-trips through interchange
expected_tests: live: save a selection to a named alpha channel, deselect, reload it from the channel and confirm identical selection
test: the channel is the same store the Channels surface (MT-050) exposes (no duplicate mechanism)

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Save & load selections (alpha channels)

risk_if_missed: Selections not persistable; save/load selection and channels become divergent stores (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
